blocks.text: A severe baggage backlog and flight delays at Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi Airport have prompted Thai Airways International Public Company Limited (THAI) to unveil an emergency recovery plan. Chief Executive Officer Chai Eamsiri pledged to “face reality” and resolve the crisis through proactive flight cancellations and third-party logistics support. Detailing the root causes of the disruption at Bangkok’s Suvarnabhumi Airport, Chai explained that specialized ground handling personnel were unable to report for duty after severe urban flooding inundated their homes. Although THAI dispatched vehicles to collect employees from their residences, many remained behind out of concern for their families and property. The resulting […]...
